units.source_text: 男人懊丧地挪开了眼睛。

en.t: The man looked away in dejection.

units.source_text: 虽说懊丧，也是一言难尽的。

en.t: Yet calling it dejection did not begin to explain it.

units.source_text: 舌尖上，残留着与干渴截然不同的奇妙感觉。

en.t: On the tip of his tongue there lingered a strange sensation utterly different from thirst.

units.source_text: 女人那傻乎乎的话，曾使他蔫了下来，

en.t: The woman's foolish words had once made him wilt,

units.source_text: 但在那之前，在极短的时间里，没有橡胶制品，他下体旺盛地跳动着，精神振奋了起来。

en.t: but before that, for one very brief moment, with no rubber article involved, his lower body had throbbed vigorously and his spirits had risen.

units.source_text: 还残留着昔别之艳阳呢。

en.t: The bright sun of an old parting still lingered there.

units.source_text: 说是发现，也许太夸张，但这毕竟还是值得注目的。

en.t: To call it a discovery might be an exaggeration, but it was still something worth noting.
